name: Moong Dal Idli with Vegetable Sambar
ingredients: ½ cup split yellow moong dal, soaked 2 hours
¼ cup idli rice, soaked 2 hours
½ cup grated carrot and chopped spinach
For quick sambar: ¼ cup cooked toor dal, ½ cup mixed vegetables, 1 tsp sambar powder, tamarind water
steps: Drain moong, rice and fenugreek. Blend with a little water to a thick batter.
Fold in carrot, spinach and salt. Rest 10 minutes; this is an instant idli, not a fermented batter.
Grease idli moulds and fill two-thirds full. Steam 12–15 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.
For sambar, simmer cooked toor dal, vegetables, sambar powder and tamarind water until vegetables are tender.
Serve two idlis per person with a bowl of hot sambar.
note: Protein estimate includes the sambar portion. Steam thoroughly; cooking time depends on mould size.
